Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics component of this study is a structural characterization using XL-MS to determine the assembly and conformational state of the Nef-CD4-AP2 complex. The 'treatment' is the application of the cross-linker DSSO to a purified protein complex to map interactions, rather than a biological perturbation of a living system.
